discovery: Audit identified gross training invoice 541431, SKU23166, 2011-01-18, quantity74215, priceGBP1.04; cancellation C541433 negates the full quantity on the same day.
rule: Pair C-prefixed negative cancellation with one positive sale sharing nonempty CustomerID, country, date, SKU, exact Decimal unit price and exact absolute quantity. FIFO source-row tie-break; use each row once. Do not partially net. Require same calendar day; unmatched rows retained in separate adjustments. Do not export customer IDs.
scope: Entire configured input window, followed by full training-only SKU selection, cost proxy, initial stock, daily series and all policy reruns.
limitations: No original-order linkage is provided; exact matches remain a diagnostic hypothesis. Matching cannot recover latent demand or observed inventory. No outcome-based tuning or arbitrary SKU deletion.
